_comment: Format terms the collector probes directly, instead of waiting for them to
reach a top-200 hashtag list. This is how you catch something like the 80s
challenge in week one rather than week three.
Add a term the moment you see it in the wild — in your For You feed, in a
competitor's caption, in a comment. Each entry is expanded through TikTok's
related-hashtags recommender on every run, and any charting hashtag, sound
or Egyptian search query containing it gets clustered onto the format row.
Keep this list short and specific. Twenty live guesses beat two hundred
stale ones. Delete anything that has been 'fading' for two weeks.
Arabic and English are both fine, and known pairs (80s / الثمانينات,
challenge / تحدي) are clustered together automatically.
